WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO public.agreement_templates (
    name,
    version,
    required_for,
    doc_url,
    active,
    documenso_template_id,
    documenso_template_envelope_id,
    documenso_member_recipient_id,
    documenso_facilitator_recipient_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at
  )
  VALUES (
    {{ this.params.name }}::text,
    {{ this.params.version }}::text,
    (
      SELECT COALESCE(array_agg(x), '{}'::text[])
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text({{ this.params.required_for_json }}::jsonb) AS t(x)
    ),
    NULLIF({{ this.params.doc_url }}, '')::text,
    COALESCE({{ this.params.active }}, true)::boolean,

    NULLIF({{ this.params.documenso_member_recipient_id }}, '')::integer,
    NULLIF({{ this.params.documenso_facilitator_recipient_id }}, '')::integer,
    now(),
    now()

),
aud AS (
  INSERT INTO public.audit_log (actor, action, entity_type, entity_id, details)

    {{ this.params.actor }}::text,

    ins.agreement_template_id::text,

WITH me AS (SELECT * FROM public.application_access({{ appsmith.user.email }}) WHERE is_document_reviewer OR is_donations_reviewer OR is_practitioner),
audit_rows AS (
  SELECT
    al.*,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(al.details::jsonb->>'member_id', '') ~*
        '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN (al.details::jsonb->>'member_id')::uuid
      ELSE NULL
    END AS scoped_detail_member_id,
    CASE
      WHEN al.entity_type = 'member'
       AND COALESCE(al.entity_id, '') ~*
        '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
      THEN al.entity_id::uuid
      ELSE NULL
    END AS scoped_entity_member_id
  FROM public.audit_log al
)
SELECT
  al.audit_log_id,
  al.created_at,
  al.actor,
  al.action,
  al.entity_type,
  al.entity_id,
  al.details,

  actor_m.first_name || ' ' || actor_m.last_name AS actor_member_name,

  member_m.member_id AS detail_member_id,
  member_m.first_name || ' ' || member_m.last_name AS detail_member_name,

  facilitator_m.member_id AS detail_facilitator_id,
  facilitator_m.first_name || ' ' || facilitator_m.last_name AS detail_facilitator_name

FROM audit_rows al
CROSS JOIN me

LEFT JOIN public.member_profiles actor_m
  ON lower(actor_m.email) = lower(al.actor)

LEFT JOIN public.member_profiles member_m
  ON member_m.member_id = al.scoped_detail_member_id

LEFT JOIN public.member_profiles facilitator_m
  ON facilitator_m.member_id = CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(al.details::jsonb->>'facilitator_id', '') ~*
      '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[1-5][0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
    THEN (al.details::jsonb->>'facilitator_id')::uuid
    ELSE NULL
  END

LEFT JOIN public.releases release_entity
  ON al.entity_type IN ('release', 'sacrament_release')
 AND release_entity.release_id::text = al.entity_id

LEFT JOIN public.donations donation_entity
  ON al.entity_type = 'donation'
 AND donation_entity.donation_id::text = al.entity_id

LEFT JOIN public.contributor_member_links donation_contributor_link
  ON donation_contributor_link.contributor_id = donation_entity.contributor_id
 AND donation_contributor_link.status = 'active'

WHERE
 (me.is_donations_reviewer OR (al.entity_type NOT IN ('donation','cash_deposit_batch','cash_deposit_item','cash_deposit_sync','contributor')
  AND al.action !~ '^(donation[.]|cash_|givebutter[.]|contributor[.])'))
 AND (
  (me.is_document_reviewer AND al.entity_type NOT IN ('donation','cash_deposit_batch','cash_deposit_item','cash_deposit_sync','contributor') AND al.action !~ '^(donation[.]|cash_|givebutter[.]|contributor[.])')
  OR (me.is_donations_reviewer AND (al.entity_type IN ('donation','cash_deposit_batch','cash_deposit_item','cash_deposit_sync','contributor') OR al.action ~ '^(donation[.]|cash_|givebutter[.]|contributor[.])'))
  OR lower(al.actor) = me.email
  OR EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM public.member_practitioner_assignments mf
    WHERE me.is_practitioner AND mf.practitioner_person_id = me.person_id
      AND mf.status = 'active'
      AND mf.member_id = COALESCE(
        al.scoped_detail_member_id,
        al.scoped_entity_member_id,
        release_entity.member_id,
        donation_entity.member_id,
        donation_contributor_link.member_id
      )
  )

 )
ORDER BY al.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

WITH access AS (
 SELECT public.issue19_has_role({{ appsmith.user.email }},'donations_reviewer') AS allowed
)
SELECT
  d.donation_id,
  d.created_at,
  d.donated_at,
  d.amount_cents,
  d.currency,
  d.donor_kind,
  d.member_id,
  d.contributor_id,
  CASE
    WHEN d.donor_kind = 'anonymous' THEN 'Anonymous'
    ELSE COALESCE(c.display_name, d.member_id::text)
  END AS donor_name,
  c.contributor_type,
  d.status AS donation_status,
  CASE
    WHEN e.exclusion_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'deposit_reconciliation_excluded'
    WHEN b.status = 'confirmed' THEN 'deposit_confirmed'
    WHEN b.status = 'prepared' THEN 'deposit_prepared'
    WHEN b.status = 'draft' THEN 'assigned_to_deposit_batch'
    WHEN d.status = 'pending_review' THEN 'pending_review'
    WHEN d.status = 'verified' THEN 'cash_on_hand'
    ELSE d.status
  END AS operational_status,
  b.deposit_batch_id,
  b.status AS batch_status,
  e.exclusion_id,
  e.excluded_at,
  e.excluded_by,
  e.reason AS exclusion_reason,
  e.notes AS exclusion_notes,
  d.notes,
  d.review_notes
FROM public.donations d
LEFT JOIN public.contributor_profiles c
  ON c.contributor_id = d.contributor_id
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT
    b.deposit_batch_id,
    b.status
  FROM public.cash_deposit_batch_items i
  JOIN public.cash_deposit_batches b
    ON b.deposit_batch_id = i.deposit_batch_id
  WHERE i.donation_id = d.donation_id
    AND i.removed_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
) b ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN public.cash_deposit_donation_exclusions e
  ON e.donation_id = d.donation_id
CROSS JOIN access a
WHERE a.allowed
  AND d.provider = 'cash'
  AND d.donor_kind IN ('identified', 'anonymous')
  AND (
    {{ selCashDepositStatus.selectedOptionValue || "ALL" }} = 'ALL'
    OR
    (
      CASE
        WHEN e.exclusion_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'deposit_reconciliation_excluded'
        WHEN b.status = 'confirmed' THEN 'deposit_confirmed'
        WHEN b.status = 'prepared' THEN 'deposit_prepared'
        WHEN b.status = 'draft' THEN 'assigned_to_deposit_batch'
        WHEN d.status = 'pending_review' THEN 'pending_review'
        WHEN d.status = 'verified' THEN 'cash_on_hand'
        ELSE d.status
      END
    ) = {{ selCashDepositStatus.selectedOptionValue }}
  )
  AND (
    {{ appsmith.store.cash_deposit_hide_ineligible !== false }}
    AND (
      d.status = 'pending_review'
      OR (
        d.status = 'verified'
        AND b.deposit_batch_id IS NULL
        AND e.exclusion_id IS NULL
      )
    )
    OR
    {{ appsmith.store.cash_deposit_hide_ineligible === false }}
  )
ORDER BY d.donated_at DESC NULLS LAST, d.created_at DESC, d.donation_id;

WITH target AS (
 SELECT e.contributor_email_id,e.contributor_id
 FROM public.contributor_emails e
 JOIN public.contributors c ON c.contributor_id=e.contributor_id
 WHERE e.contributor_email_id={{ selCompanyDonorContactToArchive.selectedOptionValue || null }}::uuid
   AND e.status='active' AND c.status='active' AND c.contributor_type='organization'
   AND c.organization_id={{ qCompanyProfile.data?.[0]?.party_id || null }}::uuid
   AND public.issue19_has_role({{ appsmith.user.email }},'donations_reviewer')
), cleared AS (
 UPDATE public.contributor_emails e SET is_primary=false,updated_at=now()
 WHERE e.contributor_id=(SELECT contributor_id FROM target)
   AND e.contributor_email_id<>(SELECT contributor_email_id FROM target)
   AND e.status='active' AND e.is_primary=true
 RETURNING e.contributor_email_id
), updated AS (
 UPDATE public.contributor_emails e SET is_primary=true,updated_at=now()
 WHERE e.contributor_email_id=(SELECT contributor_email_id FROM target)
   AND (SELECT count(*) FROM cleared)>=0
 RETURNING e.contributor_email_id
), audit AS (
 INSERT INTO public.audit_log(actor,action,entity_type,entity_id,details)
 SELECT lower({{ appsmith.user.email }}),'contributor.email.primary','contributor_email',
 updated.contributor_email_id::text,'{}'::jsonb FROM updated

SELECT DISTINCT

  m.first_name,
  m.last_name,
  m.email,
  m.phone,
  m.status,
  m.is_facilitator,
  m.created_at,

  concat_ws(' ',
    m.member_id::text,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT me2.email, ' ')
      FROM public.member_emails me2
      WHERE me2.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(me2.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), ''),
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT mp.phone, ' ')
      FROM public.member_phones mp
      WHERE mp.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(mp.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), ''),
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(
        DISTINCT concat_ws(' ', ma.address_1, ma.address_2, ma.city, ma.state, ma.postal_code, ma.country),
        ' '
      )
      FROM public.member_addresses ma
      WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(ma.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), '')
  ) AS member_search_text,

  (
    SELECT ma.status
    FROM public.member_agreements ma
    JOIN public.agreement_templates at
      ON at.agreement_template_id = ma.agreement_template_id
    WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id
      AND 'sacrament_release' = ANY(COALESCE(at.required_for, ARRAY[]::text[]))
    ORDER BY
      CASE
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('signed', 'complete', 'completed') THEN 0
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('pending_review', 'pending_signature') THEN 1
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('expired', 'rejected', 'canceled', 'cancelled') THEN 2
        ELSE 3
      END,
      ma.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS latest_release_agreement_status,

  (
    SELECT max(sr.released_at)
    FROM public.releases sr
    WHERE sr.member_id = m.member_id
  ) AS last_release_at

FROM public.member_profiles m
CROSS JOIN me
WHERE
  m.status = 'active'
  AND (
    me.is_document_reviewer = TRUE
    OR (
      me.member_id IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        m.created_by_facilitator_id = me.member_id
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.member_facilitators mf
          WHERE mf.member_id = m.member_id
            AND mf.facilitator_id = me.member_id
            AND mf.status = 'active'
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.member_agreements ma
          WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id
            AND ma.facilitator_id = me.member_id
        )
        OR EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM public.releases sr
          WHERE sr.member_id = m.member_id
            AND sr.facilitator_id = me.member_id
        )
      )
    )
  )
ORDER BY m.last_name NULLS LAST, m.first_name NULLS LAST, m.created_at DESC
LIMIT 500;

    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.person_roles r WHERE r.person_id=m.person_id)
      OR m.is_facilitator OR m.is_document_reviewer OR m.is_donations_reviewer
      THEN 'Remove the person''s appointments and permissions (including legacy reviewer or facilitator flags) before ending membership.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.member_facilitators f
      WHERE f.facilitator_id=m.member_id AND f.status='active')
      THEN 'Reassign or end this facilitator''s active member assignments before ending membership.'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.member_agreements a
      WHERE a.member_id=m.member_id AND a.status IN

SELECT guarded.* FROM (
WITH input AS (
  SELECT
    NULLIF(lower(btrim({{ this.params.first_name || "" }})), '') AS first_name,
    NULLIF(lower(btrim({{ this.params.last_name || "" }})), '') AS last_name,
    NULLIF(lower(btrim({{ this.params.email || "" }})), '') AS email_normalized,
    NULLIF(public.normalize_us_phone({{ this.params.phone || "" }}), '') AS phone_normalized,
    NULLIF({{ this.params.date_of_birth || "" }}, '')::date AS date_of_birth
),
actor AS (
  SELECT a.member_id, a.is_document_reviewer
  FROM public.application_access({{ appsmith.user.email }}::text) a
  WHERE a.is_document_reviewer
),
email_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'email'::text AS matched_field,
    me.email::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    100 AS score,
    'Active email already belongs to this member.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_emails me
    ON i.email_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND me.email_normalized = i.email_normalized
   AND COALESCE(me.status, 'active') = 'active'
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON m.member_id = me.member_id
   AND m.status = 'active'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'members.email'::text AS matched_field,
    m.email::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    95 AS score,
    'Compatibility email cache on an active member matches.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON i.email_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND lower(btrim(m.email)) = i.email_normalized
   AND m.status = 'active'
),
phone_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'phone'::text AS matched_field,
    mp.phone::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    90 AS score,
    'Phone already belongs to an active member.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_phones mp
    ON i.phone_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND mp.phone_normalized = i.phone_normalized
   AND COALESCE(mp.status, 'active') = 'active'
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON m.member_id = mp.member_id
   AND m.status = 'active'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'members.phone'::text AS matched_field,
    m.phone::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    85 AS score,
    'Compatibility phone cache on an active member matches.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON i.phone_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND public.normalize_us_phone(m.phone) = i.phone_normalized
   AND m.status = 'active'
),
name_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth THEN 'name+dob' ELSE 'name' END::text AS matched_field,
    concat_ws(' ', m.first_name, m.last_name, m.date_of_birth::text)::text AS matched_value,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth THEN 'hard' ELSE 'warning' END::text AS match_severity,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth THEN 90 ELSE 50 END AS score,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth
         THEN 'Active member has the same first name, last name, and date of birth.'
         ELSE 'Active member has the same first and last name; verify before continuing.'
    END::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON i.first_name IS NOT NULL
   AND i.last_name IS NOT NULL
   AND lower(btrim(m.first_name)) = i.first_name
   AND lower(btrim(m.last_name)) = i.last_name
   AND m.status = 'active'
),
ranked_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (member_id, matched_field, matched_value)
    member_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone,
    status,
    matched_field,
    matched_value,
    match_severity,
    explanation,
    score
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM email_matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM phone_matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM name_matches
  ) matches
  ORDER BY
    member_id,
    matched_field,
    matched_value,
    CASE WHEN match_severity = 'hard' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    score DESC
),
scoped_matches AS (
  SELECT
    rm.*,
    (
      COALESCE(a.is_document_reviewer, FALSE)
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_facilitators mf
        WHERE mf.member_id = rm.member_id
          AND mf.facilitator_id = a.member_id
          AND mf.status = 'active'
      )
    ) AS is_accessible,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(a.is_document_reviewer, FALSE) THEN 'reviewer'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_facilitators mf
        WHERE mf.member_id = rm.member_id
          AND mf.facilitator_id = a.member_id
          AND mf.status = 'active'
      ) THEN 'assigned'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_facilitators mf
        WHERE mf.member_id = rm.member_id
          AND mf.status = 'active'
      ) THEN 'other_facilitator'
      ELSE 'unassigned'
    END::text AS access_scope
  FROM ranked_matches rm
  LEFT JOIN actor a ON TRUE
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS member_id,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN first_name ELSE NULL END AS first_name,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN last_name ELSE NULL END AS last_name,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN email ELSE NULL END AS email,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN phone ELSE NULL END AS phone,
  status,
  matched_field,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN matched_value ELSE NULL END AS matched_value,
  match_severity,
  explanation,
  score,
  is_accessible,
  access_scope
FROM scoped_matches
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN match_severity = 'hard' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  score DESC,
  matched_field
LIMIT 10
) guarded WHERE public.issue19_has_role({{ appsmith.user.email }},'document_reviewer');

    NULLIF(lower(btrim({{ this.params.email || "" }})), '') AS email_normalized,
    NULLIF(public.normalize_us_phone({{ this.params.phone || "" }}), '') AS phone_normalized,
    NULLIF({{ this.params.date_of_birth || "" }}, '')::date AS date_of_birth
),
actor AS (
  SELECT a.member_id, a.is_document_reviewer
  FROM public.application_access({{ appsmith.user.email }}::text) a
  WHERE a.is_document_reviewer
),
email_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'email'::text AS matched_field,
    me.email::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    100 AS score,
    'Active email already belongs to this member.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_emails me
    ON i.email_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND me.email_normalized = i.email_normalized
   AND COALESCE(me.status, 'active') = 'active'
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON m.member_id = me.member_id
   AND m.status = 'active'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'members.email'::text AS matched_field,
    m.email::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    95 AS score,
    'Compatibility email cache on an active member matches.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON i.email_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND lower(btrim(m.email)) = i.email_normalized
   AND m.status = 'active'
),
phone_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'phone'::text AS matched_field,
    mp.phone::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    90 AS score,
    'Phone already belongs to an active member.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_phones mp
    ON i.phone_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND mp.phone_normalized = i.phone_normalized
   AND COALESCE(mp.status, 'active') = 'active'
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON m.member_id = mp.member_id
   AND m.status = 'active'

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    'members.phone'::text AS matched_field,
    m.phone::text AS matched_value,
    'hard'::text AS match_severity,
    85 AS score,
    'Compatibility phone cache on an active member matches.'::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON i.phone_normalized IS NOT NULL
   AND public.normalize_us_phone(m.phone) = i.phone_normalized
   AND m.status = 'active'
),
name_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.member_id,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    m.status,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth THEN 'name+dob' ELSE 'name' END::text AS matched_field,
    concat_ws(' ', m.first_name, m.last_name, m.date_of_birth::text)::text AS matched_value,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth THEN 'hard' ELSE 'warning' END::text AS match_severity,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth THEN 90 ELSE 50 END AS score,
    CASE WHEN i.date_of_birth IS NOT NULL AND m.date_of_birth = i.date_of_birth
         THEN 'Active member has the same first name, last name, and date of birth.'
         ELSE 'Active member has the same first and last name; verify before continuing.'
    END::text AS explanation
  FROM input i
  JOIN public.member_profiles m
    ON i.first_name IS NOT NULL
   AND i.last_name IS NOT NULL
   AND lower(btrim(m.first_name)) = i.first_name
   AND lower(btrim(m.last_name)) = i.last_name
   AND m.status = 'active'
),
ranked_matches AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (member_id, matched_field, matched_value)
    member_id,
    first_name,
    last_name,
    email,
    phone,
    status,
    matched_field,
    matched_value,
    match_severity,
    explanation,
    score
  FROM (
    SELECT * FROM email_matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM phone_matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT * FROM name_matches
  ) matches
  ORDER BY
    member_id,
    matched_field,
    matched_value,
    CASE WHEN match_severity = 'hard' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
    score DESC
),
scoped_matches AS (
  SELECT
    rm.*,
    (
      COALESCE(a.is_document_reviewer, FALSE)
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_facilitators mf
        WHERE mf.member_id = rm.member_id
          AND mf.facilitator_id = a.member_id
          AND mf.status = 'active'
      )
    ) AS is_accessible,
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(a.is_document_reviewer, FALSE) THEN 'reviewer'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_facilitators mf
        WHERE mf.member_id = rm.member_id
          AND mf.facilitator_id = a.member_id
          AND mf.status = 'active'
      ) THEN 'assigned'
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_facilitators mf
        WHERE mf.member_id = rm.member_id
          AND mf.status = 'active'
      ) THEN 'other_facilitator'
      ELSE 'unassigned'
    END::text AS access_scope
  FROM ranked_matches rm
  LEFT JOIN actor a ON TRUE
)
SELECT
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN member_id ELSE NULL END AS member_id,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN first_name ELSE NULL END AS first_name,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN last_name ELSE NULL END AS last_name,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN email ELSE NULL END AS email,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN phone ELSE NULL END AS phone,
  status,
  matched_field,
  CASE WHEN is_accessible THEN matched_value ELSE NULL END AS matched_value,
  match_severity,
  explanation,
  score,
  is_accessible,
  access_scope
FROM scoped_matches
ORDER BY
  CASE WHEN match_severity = 'hard' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
  score DESC,
  matched_field
LIMIT 10
) guarded WHERE public.issue19_has_role({{ appsmith.user.email }},'document_reviewer');

    WHERE me2.member_id = m.member_id

    WHERE mp.member_id = m.member_id

      ' '
    )
    FROM public.member_addresses ma

  ), '') AS member_addresses_search,

  concat_ws(' ',

    m.email,
    m.phone,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT me2.email, ' ')
      FROM public.member_emails me2
      WHERE me2.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(me2.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), ''),

      FROM public.member_phones mp
      WHERE mp.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(mp.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), ''),

        ' '
      )
      FROM public.member_addresses ma
      WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id

      CASE

        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('pending_review', 'pending_signature') THEN 1
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('expired', 'rejected', 'canceled', 'cancelled') THEN 2
        ELSE 3
      END,
      ma.signed_at DESC NULLS LAST,
      ma.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS latest_release_agreement_status,

  (

      AND COALESCE(me2.status, 'active') = 'active'
  ), '') AS member_emails_search,

  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT mp.phone, ' ')
    FROM public.member_phones mp
    WHERE mp.member_id = m.member_id
      AND COALESCE(mp.status, 'active') = 'active'
  ), '') AS member_phones_search,

  COALESCE((
    SELECT string_agg(
      DISTINCT concat_ws(' ', ma.address_1, ma.address_2, ma.city, ma.state, ma.postal_code, ma.country),
      ' '
    )
    FROM public.member_addresses ma
    WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id
      AND COALESCE(ma.status, 'active') = 'active'
  ), '') AS member_addresses_search,

  concat_ws(' ',
    m.member_id::text,
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    m.email,
    m.phone,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT me2.email, ' ')
      FROM public.member_emails me2
      WHERE me2.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(me2.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), ''),
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT mp.phone, ' ')
      FROM public.member_phones mp
      WHERE mp.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(mp.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), ''),
    COALESCE((
      SELECT string_agg(
        DISTINCT concat_ws(' ', ma.address_1, ma.address_2, ma.city, ma.state, ma.postal_code, ma.country),
        ' '
      )
      FROM public.member_addresses ma
      WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id
        AND COALESCE(ma.status, 'active') = 'active'
    ), '')
  ) AS member_search_text,

  (
    SELECT ma.status
    FROM public.member_agreements ma
    LEFT JOIN public.agreement_templates at
      ON at.agreement_template_id = ma.agreement_template_id
    WHERE ma.member_id = m.member_id
      AND (
        'sacrament_release' = ANY(COALESCE(at.required_for, ARRAY[]::text[]))
        OR (
          ma.agreement_template_id IS NULL
          AND lower(COALESCE(ma.signature_method, '')) IN ('paper', 'manual')
        )
      )
    ORDER BY
      CASE
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('signed', 'complete', 'completed') THEN 0
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('pending_review', 'pending_signature') THEN 1
        WHEN lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('expired', 'rejected', 'canceled', 'cancelled') THEN 2
        ELSE 3
      END,
      ma.signed_at DESC NULLS LAST,
      ma.created_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) AS latest_release_agreement_status,

  (
    SELECT max(sr.released_at)
    FROM public.releases sr
    WHERE sr.member_id = m.member_id
  ) AS last_release_at

WITH raw_params AS (
  SELECT
    lower(NULLIF({{ this.params?.bucket || 'month' }}, ''))::text AS requested_bucket,

    GREATEST(
      1,
      LEAST(
        COALESCE(NULLIF({{ this.params?.periods || '12' }}, '')::int, 12),
        120
      )
    ) AS requested_periods,

    NULLIF({{ this.params?.start_date || '' }}, '')::timestamptz AS start_override,
    NULLIF({{ this.params?.end_date || '' }}, '')::timestamptz AS end_override,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF({{ this.params?.metric_keys_json || '[]' }}, '')::jsonb,
      '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS metric_keys_json,

    lower({{ appsmith.user.email }})::text AS current_email
),

params AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN requested_bucket IN ('day', 'week', 'month', 'year')
        THEN requested_bucket
      ELSE 'month'
    END AS bucket,

    CASE
      WHEN requested_bucket = 'day' THEN interval '1 day'
      WHEN requested_bucket = 'week' THEN interval '1 week'
      WHEN requested_bucket = 'year' THEN interval '1 year'
      ELSE interval '1 month'
    END AS step,

    CASE
      WHEN requested_bucket = 'day' THEN 'YYYY-MM-DD'
      WHEN requested_bucket = 'week' THEN 'IYYY-"W"IW'
      WHEN requested_bucket = 'year' THEN 'YYYY'
      ELSE 'YYYY-MM'
    END AS label_format,

    requested_periods,
    start_override,
    end_override,
    metric_keys_json,
    current_email
  FROM raw_params
),

me AS (
  SELECT person_id, member_id, is_practitioner,
         is_document_reviewer, is_donations_reviewer
  FROM public.issue19_current_release_actor((SELECT current_email FROM params))
  WHERE is_practitioner OR is_document_reviewer OR is_donations_reviewer
),

auth AS (
  SELECT
    p.*,
    me.person_id AS viewer_person_id,
    me.is_practitioner,
    me.is_document_reviewer,
    me.is_donations_reviewer
  FROM params p
  JOIN me ON TRUE
),

bounds AS (
  SELECT
    bucket,
    step,
    label_format,
    metric_keys_json,

    date_trunc(
      bucket,
      COALESCE(
        start_override,
        date_trunc(bucket, now()) - ((requested_periods - 1) * step)
      )
    ) AS start_ts,

    date_trunc(
      bucket,
      COALESCE(end_override, now())
    ) + step AS exclusive_end_ts
  FROM auth
),

buckets AS (
  SELECT
    gs AS bucket_start,
    gs + b.step AS bucket_end,
    b.label_format
  FROM bounds b
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(
    b.start_ts,
    b.exclusive_end_ts - b.step,
    b.step
  ) AS gs
),

scoped_members AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    m.member_id
  FROM public.member_profiles m
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  WHERE lower(COALESCE(m.status, 'active')) = 'active'
    AND (
      a.is_document_reviewer IS TRUE
      OR (a.is_practitioner AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM public.member_practitioner_assignments assignment
        WHERE assignment.member_id = m.member_id
          AND assignment.practitioner_person_id = a.viewer_person_id
          AND assignment.status = 'active'
      ))
    )
),

scoped_donations AS (
  SELECT d.*, contributor.contributor_type,
         EXISTS (
           SELECT 1 FROM public.members participant
           WHERE participant.person_id = contributor.person_id
             AND participant.status = 'active'
         ) AS has_participant_capacity
  FROM public.donations d
  LEFT JOIN public.contributors contributor
    ON contributor.contributor_id = d.contributor_id
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  WHERE a.is_donations_reviewer IS TRUE
    AND d.donor_kind IN ('identified', 'anonymous', 'unresolved')
),

selected_metrics AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT 'agreements_signed'::text AS metric_key, 'Agreements signed'::text AS metric_label, 10 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL SELECT 'releases_sent', 'Releases sent', 20
    UNION ALL SELECT 'donations_count', 'Donations received', 30
    UNION ALL SELECT 'donations_dollars', 'Donation dollars', 40
    UNION ALL SELECT 'contributor_donations_count', 'Contributor-linked donations', 45
    UNION ALL SELECT 'contributor_donations_dollars', 'Contributor-linked donation dollars', 46
    UNION ALL SELECT 'participant_donations_count', 'Participant-linked donations (subset)', 50
    UNION ALL SELECT 'participant_donations_dollars', 'Participant-linked donation dollars (subset)', 60
    UNION ALL SELECT 'anonymous_donations_count', 'Anonymous donations', 70
    UNION ALL SELECT 'anonymous_donations_dollars', 'Anonymous donation dollars', 80
    UNION ALL SELECT 'individual_donations_count', 'Individual contributor donations', 90
    UNION ALL SELECT 'individual_donations_dollars', 'Individual contributor donation dollars', 100
    UNION ALL SELECT 'organization_donations_count', 'Company contributor donations', 110
    UNION ALL SELECT 'organization_donations_dollars', 'Company contributor donation dollars', 120
    UNION ALL SELECT 'unresolved_donations_count', 'Unresolved donations', 130
    UNION ALL SELECT 'unresolved_donations_dollars', 'Unresolved donation dollars', 140
    UNION ALL SELECT 'participants_created', 'Participants created', 150
    UNION ALL SELECT 'contributors_created', 'Contributors created', 160
  ) m
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  WHERE (
    a.is_donations_reviewer IS TRUE
    OR m.metric_key NOT IN (
      'donations_count',
      'donations_dollars',
      'contributor_donations_count', 'contributor_donations_dollars', 'contributors_created',
      'participant_donations_count',
      'participant_donations_dollars',
      'anonymous_donations_count',
      'anonymous_donations_dollars',
      'individual_donations_count', 'individual_donations_dollars',
      'organization_donations_count', 'organization_donations_dollars',
      'unresolved_donations_count', 'unresolved_donations_dollars'
    )
  )
  AND (
    jsonb_array_length(b.metric_keys_json) = 0
    OR m.metric_key IN (
      -- Accept retained development selections without exposing legacy labels.
      SELECT CASE value
        WHEN 'members_created' THEN 'participants_created'
        WHEN 'member_donations_count' THEN 'participant_donations_count'
        WHEN 'member_donations_dollars' THEN 'participant_donations_dollars'
        ELSE value END
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(b.metric_keys_json)
    )
  )
),

agreement_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bucket_start,
    'agreements_signed'::text AS metric_key,
    COUNT(ma.member_agreement_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  LEFT JOIN public.member_agreements ma
    ON ma.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM scoped_members)
   AND lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('signed', 'complete', 'completed')
   AND COALESCE(ma.signed_at, ma.reviewed_at, ma.updated_at) >= b.bucket_start
   AND COALESCE(ma.signed_at, ma.reviewed_at, ma.updated_at) < b.bucket_end
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

release_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bucket_start,
    'releases_sent'::text AS metric_key,
    COUNT(r.release_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  LEFT JOIN public.releases r
    ON r.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM scoped_members)
   AND COALESCE(r.released_at, r.created_at) >= b.bucket_start
   AND COALESCE(r.released_at, r.created_at) < b.bucket_end
   AND lower(COALESCE(r.status, 'issued')) <> 'voided'
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

donation_metrics AS (
  SELECT b.bucket_start, category.metric_key,
         CASE WHEN category.is_dollars
           THEN COALESCE(SUM(d.amount_cents), 0)::numeric / 100.0
           ELSE COUNT(d.donation_id)::numeric
         END AS value
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES
    ('donations_count', 'all', false), ('donations_dollars', 'all', true),
    ('contributor_donations_count', 'contributor', false),
    ('contributor_donations_dollars', 'contributor', true),
    ('participant_donations_count', 'participant', false),
    ('participant_donations_dollars', 'participant', true),
    ('anonymous_donations_count', 'anonymous', false),
    ('anonymous_donations_dollars', 'anonymous', true),
    ('individual_donations_count', 'individual', false),
    ('individual_donations_dollars', 'individual', true),
    ('organization_donations_count', 'organization', false),
    ('organization_donations_dollars', 'organization', true),
    ('unresolved_donations_count', 'unresolved', false),
    ('unresolved_donations_dollars', 'unresolved', true)
  ) category(metric_key, kind, is_dollars)
  LEFT JOIN scoped_donations d
    ON COALESCE(d.donated_at, d.created_at) >= b.bucket_start
   AND COALESCE(d.donated_at, d.created_at) < b.bucket_end
   AND lower(COALESCE(d.status, '')) IN ('verified', 'imported', 'pending_review')
   AND (category.kind = 'all'
     OR (category.kind = 'contributor' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_id IS NOT NULL AND d.contributor_type IN ('individual', 'organization'))
     OR (category.kind = 'participant' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_type = 'individual' AND d.has_participant_capacity)
     OR (category.kind = 'individual' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_type = 'individual')
     OR (category.kind = 'organization' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_type = 'organization')
     OR (category.kind IN ('anonymous', 'unresolved')
         AND d.donor_kind = category.kind))
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start, category.metric_key, category.is_dollars
),

participant_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bucket_start,
    'participants_created'::text AS metric_key,
    COUNT(m.member_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  LEFT JOIN public.members m
    ON (a.is_document_reviewer IS TRUE OR (a.is_practitioner IS TRUE AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.member_practitioner_assignments assignment
      WHERE assignment.member_id = m.member_id
        AND assignment.practitioner_person_id = a.viewer_person_id
        AND assignment.status = 'active'
    )))
   AND m.created_at >= b.bucket_start
   AND m.created_at < b.bucket_end
   AND lower(COALESCE(m.status, 'active')) <> 'deleted'
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

-- Capacity creation is distinct from person/company creation. Later archive/merge
-- or an ended enrollment must not erase a historical creation event.
contributor_counts AS (
  SELECT b.bucket_start, 'contributors_created'::text AS metric_key,
         COUNT(c.contributor_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  LEFT JOIN public.contributors c
    ON a.is_donations_reviewer IS TRUE
   AND c.created_at >= b.bucket_start
   AND c.created_at < b.bucket_end
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

all_metric_values AS (
  SELECT * FROM agreement_counts
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM release_counts
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM donation_metrics
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM participant_counts
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM contributor_counts
)

SELECT
  mv.bucket_start,
  to_char(mv.bucket_start, b.label_format) AS bucket_label,
  mv.metric_key,
  sm.metric_label,
  sm.sort_order,
  mv.value
FROM all_metric_values mv
JOIN selected_metrics sm
  ON sm.metric_key = mv.metric_key
CROSS JOIN bounds b
ORDER BY mv.bucket_start, sm.sort_order;

  WHERE a.is_donations_reviewer IS TRUE
    AND d.donor_kind IN ('identified', 'anonymous', 'unresolved')
),

selected_metrics AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM (
    SELECT 'agreements_signed'::text AS metric_key, 'Agreements signed'::text AS metric_label, 10 AS sort_order
    UNION ALL SELECT 'releases_sent', 'Releases sent', 20
    UNION ALL SELECT 'donations_count', 'Donations received', 30
    UNION ALL SELECT 'donations_dollars', 'Donation dollars', 40
    UNION ALL SELECT 'contributor_donations_count', 'Contributor-linked donations', 45
    UNION ALL SELECT 'contributor_donations_dollars', 'Contributor-linked donation dollars', 46
    UNION ALL SELECT 'participant_donations_count', 'Participant-linked donations (subset)', 50
    UNION ALL SELECT 'participant_donations_dollars', 'Participant-linked donation dollars (subset)', 60
    UNION ALL SELECT 'anonymous_donations_count', 'Anonymous donations', 70
    UNION ALL SELECT 'anonymous_donations_dollars', 'Anonymous donation dollars', 80
    UNION ALL SELECT 'individual_donations_count', 'Individual contributor donations', 90
    UNION ALL SELECT 'individual_donations_dollars', 'Individual contributor donation dollars', 100
    UNION ALL SELECT 'organization_donations_count', 'Company contributor donations', 110
    UNION ALL SELECT 'organization_donations_dollars', 'Company contributor donation dollars', 120
    UNION ALL SELECT 'unresolved_donations_count', 'Unresolved donations', 130
    UNION ALL SELECT 'unresolved_donations_dollars', 'Unresolved donation dollars', 140
    UNION ALL SELECT 'participants_created', 'Participants created', 150
    UNION ALL SELECT 'contributors_created', 'Contributors created', 160
  ) m
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  WHERE (
    a.is_donations_reviewer IS TRUE
    OR m.metric_key NOT IN (
      'donations_count',
      'donations_dollars',
      'contributor_donations_count', 'contributor_donations_dollars', 'contributors_created',
      'participant_donations_count',
      'participant_donations_dollars',
      'anonymous_donations_count',
      'anonymous_donations_dollars',
      'individual_donations_count', 'individual_donations_dollars',
      'organization_donations_count', 'organization_donations_dollars',
      'unresolved_donations_count', 'unresolved_donations_dollars'
    )
  )
  AND (
    jsonb_array_length(b.metric_keys_json) = 0
    OR m.metric_key IN (
      -- Accept retained development selections without exposing legacy labels.
      SELECT CASE value
        WHEN 'members_created' THEN 'participants_created'
        WHEN 'member_donations_count' THEN 'participant_donations_count'
        WHEN 'member_donations_dollars' THEN 'participant_donations_dollars'
        ELSE value END
      FROM jsonb_array_elements_text(b.metric_keys_json)
    )
  )
),

agreement_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bucket_start,
    'agreements_signed'::text AS metric_key,
    COUNT(ma.member_agreement_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  LEFT JOIN public.member_agreements ma
    ON ma.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM scoped_members)
   AND lower(COALESCE(ma.status, '')) IN ('signed', 'complete', 'completed')
   AND COALESCE(ma.signed_at, ma.reviewed_at, ma.updated_at) >= b.bucket_start
   AND COALESCE(ma.signed_at, ma.reviewed_at, ma.updated_at) < b.bucket_end
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

release_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bucket_start,
    'releases_sent'::text AS metric_key,
    COUNT(r.release_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  LEFT JOIN public.releases r
    ON r.member_id IN (SELECT member_id FROM scoped_members)
   AND COALESCE(r.released_at, r.created_at) >= b.bucket_start
   AND COALESCE(r.released_at, r.created_at) < b.bucket_end
   AND lower(COALESCE(r.status, 'issued')) <> 'voided'
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

donation_metrics AS (
  SELECT b.bucket_start, category.metric_key,
         CASE WHEN category.is_dollars
           THEN COALESCE(SUM(d.amount_cents), 0)::numeric / 100.0
           ELSE COUNT(d.donation_id)::numeric
         END AS value
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES
    ('donations_count', 'all', false), ('donations_dollars', 'all', true),
    ('contributor_donations_count', 'contributor', false),
    ('contributor_donations_dollars', 'contributor', true),
    ('participant_donations_count', 'participant', false),
    ('participant_donations_dollars', 'participant', true),
    ('anonymous_donations_count', 'anonymous', false),
    ('anonymous_donations_dollars', 'anonymous', true),
    ('individual_donations_count', 'individual', false),
    ('individual_donations_dollars', 'individual', true),
    ('organization_donations_count', 'organization', false),
    ('organization_donations_dollars', 'organization', true),
    ('unresolved_donations_count', 'unresolved', false),
    ('unresolved_donations_dollars', 'unresolved', true)
  ) category(metric_key, kind, is_dollars)
  LEFT JOIN scoped_donations d
    ON COALESCE(d.donated_at, d.created_at) >= b.bucket_start
   AND COALESCE(d.donated_at, d.created_at) < b.bucket_end
   AND lower(COALESCE(d.status, '')) IN ('verified', 'imported', 'pending_review')
   AND (category.kind = 'all'
     OR (category.kind = 'contributor' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_id IS NOT NULL AND d.contributor_type IN ('individual', 'organization'))
     OR (category.kind = 'participant' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_type = 'individual' AND d.has_participant_capacity)
     OR (category.kind = 'individual' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_type = 'individual')
     OR (category.kind = 'organization' AND d.donor_kind = 'identified'
         AND d.contributor_type = 'organization')
     OR (category.kind IN ('anonymous', 'unresolved')
         AND d.donor_kind = category.kind))
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start, category.metric_key, category.is_dollars
),

participant_counts AS (
  SELECT
    b.bucket_start,
    'participants_created'::text AS metric_key,
    COUNT(m.member_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  LEFT JOIN public.members m
    ON (a.is_document_reviewer IS TRUE OR (a.is_practitioner IS TRUE AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM public.member_practitioner_assignments assignment
      WHERE assignment.member_id = m.member_id
        AND assignment.practitioner_person_id = a.viewer_person_id
        AND assignment.status = 'active'
    )))
   AND m.created_at >= b.bucket_start
   AND m.created_at < b.bucket_end
   AND lower(COALESCE(m.status, 'active')) <> 'deleted'
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

-- Capacity creation is distinct from person/company creation. Later archive/merge
-- or an ended enrollment must not erase a historical creation event.
contributor_counts AS (
  SELECT b.bucket_start, 'contributors_created'::text AS metric_key,
         COUNT(c.contributor_id)::numeric AS value
  FROM buckets b
  CROSS JOIN auth a
  LEFT JOIN public.contributors c
    ON a.is_donations_reviewer IS TRUE
   AND c.created_at >= b.bucket_start
   AND c.created_at < b.bucket_end
  GROUP BY b.bucket_start
),

all_metric_values AS (
  SELECT * FROM agreement_counts
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM release_counts
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM donation_metrics
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM participant_counts
  UNION ALL SELECT * FROM contributor_counts
)

SELECT
  mv.bucket_start,
  to_char(mv.bucket_start, b.label_format) AS bucket_label,
  mv.metric_key,
  sm.metric_label,
  sm.sort_order,
  mv.value
FROM all_metric_values mv
JOIN selected_metrics sm
  ON sm.metric_key = mv.metric_key
CROSS JOIN bounds b
ORDER BY mv.bucket_start, sm.sort_order;
